notes.audio_processing: Leading/trailing silence trimmed (35 dB below the loudest 20 ms frame, 0.12 s padding); loudest clip of each quartet at about -18 dBFS RMS, quieter emotions keep half of their level difference (at most 8 dB) so relative loudness is still audible; single clips at about -18 dBFS RMS; peaks at most -1 dBFS; 16 kHz mono MP3 at 64 kbps.
notes.predictions: Label = the most probable of the dataset's emotions (as in the evaluation); probability = that model's own softmax probability for the label.
